basic_info.description: Welcome home! Tucked away in San Francisco's sought-after Parkside District, this beautifully updated single-family residence showcases a desirable floor plan and timeless character.    The main level features three generous bedrooms and two stylishly refreshed bathrooms, along with a sun-filled living room anchored by a wood-burning fireplace. A formal dining room flows seamlessly into the bright kitchen, complete with a cozy eat-in nook. Two of the bedrooms overlook the expansive, terraced garden, newly landscaped with fresh plantings and thoughtful finishes. Both main-level bathrooms have been updated with modern tile floors, new vanities, and sleek shower enclosures. Fresh interior and exterior paint add the perfect finishing touch.    Downstairs, a flexible bonus room with an additional full bath offers endless possibilitiesideal for guests, a private office, or a media retreat. Hardwood floors extend throughout the home, adding warmth and character.    Additional highlights include two-car parking, generous storage, and a tiered garden that rises to a spectacular vantage point with sweeping ocean views.    Blending San Francisco charm with modern comforts, this home is truly a rare Parkside gem.
